# License Tracking | SBV Workforce Management

**Source:** https://www.sbvwm.com/software/license-tracking/

---

License tracking allows you to maintain the employee’s primary and secondary license/certification information that includes their license/certification number, expiration date, verification date and disciplinary action search date.

  * Direct online lookup of license information is available for New York and New Jersey certifications and licenses
  * Reports can be automatically generated to notify you of upcoming license expiration dates
  * Employee form letters can be generated and included with their pay check or schedule, advising the employee of upcoming expiration dates
